_setup: Fill source.owner with your actual GitHub username (or change owner_type).
Set allowance_microcredits to your approved monthly budget: 1 credit = 1000000.
Fill mapping.unit_type, product and sku using your actual billing response.
Do not guess billing units or allowance. Blank values run setup demo only.
Put Wi-Fi credentials and your GitHub token in the separate .env file.
Edit these files locally, upload them through mpremote, then reset the board.
See firmware/plasma2350w/README.md for provisioning and unlimited settings.
